content:
Al Roker on Monday left the *Today* show early without telling viewers why, but don't worry: the reason is pretty down to earth.

The longtime weatherman delivered his forecast during the first portion of the show before handing things off to fellow meteorologist Dylan Dreyer, who completed the rest of the program.

Savannah Guthrie confirmed the swap, explaining that Roker "needed to leave a little early," but didn't share further details.

By the show's third hour, Roker still hadn't returned to the studio, prompting Craig Melvin to assure viewers that "he'll be back tomorrow."

Roker later took to Instagram to explain his abrupt exit, noting it was for a very grounded reason.

"I actually left the Today Show early because I have to go report for jury duty. It's our civic duty, so do your civic duty," he explained.

He added: "I said 'duty' twice!"
